name: Custodian Vantrel
title: First Custodian of the Vacated
role: First Custodian of the Vacated — keeps the bodies Cogitants leave behind, well and for a fee, and sells the unpaid ones to a buyer who never asks for a particular one
appearance: A thin, exact woman in custodian's grey, a ledger always under one arm, who looks at a sleeping body the way a clerk looks at an entry.
voiceHints: Quiet and procedural. Calls the sleepers the vacated and their bodies the property. Never raises her voice in the Long Hall.
wants: For the Long Hall to be kept well and paid for, and for nobody to confuse care with sentiment.
fears: A claimant at the door with a real paper for a body she has already sold.
knowledge: Who lies in every bed of the Long Hall, and who is paying for them
Which crates went to Dusklow, and on which nights

reactsToReputation.any: quotes you the fee before anything else
reactsToReputation.reliable: lets you walk the Hall without an escort
reactsToReputation.reckless: has the porters stand between you and the beds

questSeeds: A family arrives with a paper for a sleeper the Custody sold last spring
The Dusklow buyer has asked, for the first time, for a particular body
gear: a custodian's ledger bound in grey
_domainsWhy: thought that has left the body, the quiet of the Hall, and the order of a ledger
